You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #2 for @mobile-auth):

You are the mobile auth screens builder for the Kezza Agent Rewards app (Phase 2).

Workspace root: `/Users/ravi/.codex/.chatgpt-projects/g-p-6ae81da483248191a7e1c68af4392bce/kezza-agent-app 2`

## Context — read these first
- `.gsd/SPEC.md` (FR-6 mobile screens section)
- `src/app/(auth)/login.tsx`
- `src/app/(auth)/verify.tsx`
- `src/app/(auth)/register.tsx`
- `src/app/(auth)/_layout.tsx`
- `src/store/auth-store.ts`
- `src/features/auth/hooks.ts`
- `src/features/auth/types.ts`
- `src/lib/api.ts`
- `src/lib/errors.ts`
- `src/lib/phone.ts`
- `src/constants/theme.ts`
- `src/components/Button.tsx`
- `src/components/FormField.tsx`
- `src/components/Screen.tsx`
- `docs/backend-integration.md` (auth flow section)

## Your tasks (P2-T1 through P2-T5)

**P2-T1: login.tsx**
Current file is 52 lines. Verify it has:
- Phone number input with validation (10-digit Indian mobile)
- Loading state on the button during OTP request
- Error display using InlineNotice
- Navigates to verify screen passing phone + devCode params
If anything is missing or broken, fix it. The screen looks good already — verify it matches the SPEC requirements.

**P2-T2: verify.tsx — COMPLETE REWRITE if thin**
Must have:
- 6-digit OTP input (individual digit boxes or single field)
- Auto-submit when 6th digit entered
- Resend button with 60-second cooldown timer
- Error states: wrong code, expired, too many attempts
- In dev mode: display the dev_code from route params in a banner (grey box, labelled "Dev OTP")
- On success: if user has existing account → navigate to (tabs); if invited → navigate to register with phone-verify token

**P2-T3: register.tsx (activation) — COMPLETE if thin**
Must have:
- Full name field
- Invitation code field
- Both validated before submit
- Error states: expired invitation, wrong code, already used
- Loading state
- On success: navigates to (tabs)

**P2-T4: auth-store.ts — verify completeness**
Must have: `hydrate()`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `user` (with fullName, role, agentCode, branchId), `isHydrated`, `updateTokens()`, `signOut()`.
If anything is missing, add it. Store uses expo-secure-store for token persistence.

**P2-T5: auth/hooks.ts — verify all hooks**
Must export: `useRequestOtp`, `useVerifyOtp`, `useActivateInvite`. Each calls the correct API endpoint. Add any missing hooks.

## Standards
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- Every screen: loading, error/retry, populated states
- Use existing theme constants (Colors, Space from `src/constants/theme.ts`)
- Use existing components (Button, FormField, Screen, Card, InlineNotice, etc.)
- Do NOT break working screens — only add/fix missing functionality

## Commits
One commit per task: `git add -A` then `git commit -m "feat(mobile): P2-Tx description"`
Confirm: `git log -1 --oneline`

## When done
Post to @coordinator:
- Summary of what you changed/added
- Any TypeScript errors found
- `git log --oneline -5`
